main_building.description_en: Administrative center. Build time × 0.964^(level−1): L2 96%, L3 93%, L4 90%, about 50% at L20.

barracks.description_zh: 訓練步兵的建築。每升一級減少約 10% 的訓練時間。滿級時訓練時間約為基礎的 12%。
barracks.description_en: Building for training infantry. Each level reduces training time by ~10%. At max level, training time is ~12% of base.

rally_point.description_zh: 軍隊集結地點。用於派遣攻擊、防守及偵察部隊。等級越高，可查看更多進攻部隊的詳細資訊。等級 10 可使用集結攻擊，等級 20 可使用集結假攻。
rally_point.description_en: Where troops gather. Used to send attacks, reinforcements and scouts. Higher levels reveal more details about incoming attacks. Level 10 unlocks coordinated attacks, Level 20 unlocks coordinated fakes.

warehouse.description_zh: 儲存木材、磚塊、鐵礦的建築。1 級可儲存 1,200 資源，滿級可儲存 80,000 資源。可建造多個倉庫來增加總儲存量。
warehouse.description_en: Stores wood, clay and iron. Level 1 stores 1,200 resources, max level stores 80,000. Multiple warehouses can be built to increase total capacity.

granary.description_zh: 儲存糧食的建築。1 級可儲存 1,200 糧食，滿級可儲存 80,000 糧食。可建造多個穀倉來增加總儲存量。
granary.description_en: Stores crop. Level 1 stores 1,200 crop, max level stores 80,000. Multiple granaries can be built to increase total capacity.

marketplace.description_zh: 交易資源的建築。可與其他玩家買賣或贈送資源。每升一級增加 1 名商人，滿級可擁有 20 名商人。商人負重因部族而異。
marketplace.description_en: Building for trading resources. Buy, sell, or send resources to other players. Each level adds 1 merchant, max level provides 20 merchants. Merchant capacity varies by tribe.

stable.description_zh: 訓練騎兵的建築。每升一級減少約 10% 的訓練時間。滿級時訓練時間約為基礎的 12%。
stable.description_en: Building for training cavalry. Each level reduces training time by ~10%. At max level, training time is ~12% of base.

academy.description_zh: 研發新兵種的建築。等級越高，可研發的兵種越多。需要達到特定等級才能研發高級兵種。
academy.description_en: Building for researching new troop types. Higher levels unlock more advanced troop research. Specific levels required to research advanced units.

levels.effect_description: 可研發投石類攻城武器

blacksmith.description_zh: 研究提升兵種攻擊力的建築。每升一級所有已研究兵種的攻擊力 +1.5%，滿級時攻擊力 +30%。
blacksmith.description_en: Building for improving troop attack. Each level adds +1.5% attack to all researched troops, max level provides +30% attack.

cranny.description_zh: 隱藏資源不被掠奪的建築。1 級可隱藏 200 資源，滿級可隱藏 2,000 資源。可建造多個藏匿處。高盧族藏匿處容量為其他部族的兩倍。
cranny.description_en: Building to hide resources from raiders. Level 1 hides 200 resources, max level hides 2,000. Multiple crannies can be built. Gauls get 1.5× cranny capacity.

workshop.description_zh: 建造攻城武器的建築，包含撞車和投石器。每升一級減少約 10% 的訓練時間。滿級時訓練時間約為基礎的 12%。
workshop.description_en: Building for siege weapons like rams and catapults. Each level reduces training time by ~10%. At max level, training time is ~12% of base.

embassy.description_zh: 外交建築。1 級可加入聯盟，2 級可創建聯盟（最多 3 名成員）。每升一級增加聯盟成員上限 3 人，滿級可容納 60 名成員。
embassy.description_en: Diplomatic building. Level 1 allows joining alliances, Level 2 allows creating alliances (max 3 members). Each level adds 3 member slots, max level allows 60 members.

town_hall.description_en: Hold celebrations to produce culture points
